en_lede: OEM vs ODM explained for overseas buyers — definitions, key differences, and when to choose build-to-print vs full development in China. 48h quote.

related_qa: What is the difference between OEM and ODM?
OEM builds to your design; ODM designs the product and you brand it. Both can be done in the Greater Bay Area.
Which is cheaper, OEM or ODM?
ODM is usually faster and cheaper to launch because development is reuse; OEM gives more control over the design.
Which should a new brand choose?
Start with ODM or private label for speed, then move to OEM as your design matures.
How do I protect IP in OEM/ODM?
Use NNN / confidentiality terms, dual-sourcing on key items, and limit full drawing release to the assigned workshop.

related_qa: How do I verify a Chinese manufacturer?
Use a by-process photo gallery, a recorded shop-floor video, a certificate wall and a live inspection by appointment — no blind trust.
What is a factory audit checklist?
Licenses, production capacity, QC process, certifications and verifiable references. We provide ours on request.
How do I avoid scams when manufacturing in China?
Verify the legal entity, use staged payments (30% deposit / 70% before shipment), request NNN, and inspect before full payment.
What does MOQ mean in manufacturing?
Minimum Order Quantity — the smallest batch a factory accepts. Ours starts at 500 pcs per SKU with consolidation.
